diagnosis.symptom: every non-overfit checkpoint speaks fluent LJ-style audio whose content ignores the input text, and generation frequently never terminates
diagnosis.assembly_verified: training input assembly was compared line-by-line against the model's own inference ICL path (text_projection + 16 codec-group embeddings) — they match
diagnosis.conclusion: the released custom-voice SFT recipe, applied to the 0.6B Base checkpoint at lr 5e-6 for 750 updates on 1000 single-speaker rows, destroys text-conditioning before it teaches the speaker identity. The official script does not even run unmodified on 0.6B (2048-vs-1024 dim crash), which is consistent with the recipe being developed and validated on 1.7B only.
diagnosis.not_claimed: that fine-tuning Qwen3-TTS is impossible in general — only that the official recipe on 0.6B in this environment (8 GB VRAM, documented adaptations) failed; a 1.7B run or an official fix may behave differently

verdict: F — FINE-TUNING FAILED; no checkpoint selectable by frozen VAL evidence
